reason: The user-supplied parameter undergoes HTML escaping via ESAPI.encodeForHTML(str) before being written to the HTTP response body, effectively mitigating XSS risks. Additionally, HtmlUtils.htmlEscape is applied in the helper function, ensuring the data is sanitized regardless of the flow path. The cookie itself is also marked Secure and HttpOnly, further reducing risk.
